verdict.rationale: Digits has a chart of accounts in its ledger, readable via the API ('Fetch the full Chart of Accounts from the Ledger'), and offers dimensional accounting and reporting on higher tiers (Core/Pro). That gives glancing support for class or tag dimensions, but nothing in the pack shows an accountant creating or editing accounts, setting account types, or nesting sub-accounts. Missing for 10: documented COA editing/customization, account-type configuration, sub-account hierarchy, detail on how dimensions are defined and applied, and hands-on corroboration.
